name: "ChinQue!" ~Chinchin no Sei to Mittsu no Negai~
original_name: 『チンクエ!』~ち○ちんの精と3つの願い~
source: One day, a fairy of dicks suddenly appeared before you and whisked you away to a world of swords and magic.  What do you have to do to return to your world, you wonder?  You were then told, "Thou must experience the smut."  You will meet many residents in a world of customs and cultures different from yours.  Will you be able to return to your world in the end...?
translation: 有一天，一位鸡巴仙子突然出现在你面前，带你进入剑与魔法的世界。你想知道你必须做什么才能回到你的世界？然后你被告知，“你必须经历色情内容。”  你将在风俗和文化与你不同的世界中遇到许多居民。最终你能回到自己的世界吗……？
